meta.name: alterlab-molecular-dynamics
meta.description: Runs and analyzes molecular dynamics simulations with OpenMM and MDAnalysis — setting up protein and small-molecule systems, assigning force fields, running energy minimization and production MD, and analyzing trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, contact maps, free energy surfaces). Use when simulating protein or ligand dynamics, equilibrating a system, or computing trajectory metrics for structural biology, drug binding, or biophysics. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.
